ute.note: The game's ute: body 5.46 m by 2.05 m, wheelbase 3.18 m, 31 inch tyres, about 0.33 m under the belly.

text.crawl: A tyre can climb it (0.40 m or lower)

text.wall: Wall (0.70 m or taller): you have to go around
